result.sql:
WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_ts) AS month_start,
         SUM(order_amount) AS total_amount,
         COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2011-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND order_ts <  TIMESTAMP '2012-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_ts)
),
monthly_aov AS (
  SELECT month_start,
         total_amount / NULLIF(invoice_count, 0) AS aov
  FROM monthly_counts
)
SELECT CAST(month_start AS STRING) AS year_month,
       aov
FROM monthly_aov
ORDER BY month_start

references.text: AOV / average order value / เฉลี่ยต่อคำสั่งซื้อ = SUM(order_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) from orders in the requested period. No customer_id filter means BOTH anonymous and identified orders are included; no extra NULL handling is required to include anonymous orders. Protect the DENOMINATOR count, not the numerator sum, from zero division. Do not average customer AOVs or product-line amounts to get overall order value.

Basket / ตะกร้า / หน่วยต่อใบ: orders.total_units is the unit count in one completed invoice; distinct_products is number of different product IDs in that invoice. AVG(total_units) means units per invoice. AVG(distinct_products) is different. Conditional count: SUM(CASE WHEN distinct_products=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END). Conditional fraction: conditional count / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0). A unit count is not a count of product lines or distinct products.

sales_lines: one ORIGINAL PRODUCT LINE per row; never one invoice per row. invoice_id/customer_id/product_id strings; description string; invoice_ts timestamp; country string; quantity bigint; unit_price decimal; line_amount decimal; transaction_type string; source_sheet string; source_row bigint. Types are sale, cancellation, return, adjustment, invalid; 'completed' is NOT a type. For product revenue/units use transaction_type='sale', then sum line_amount/quantity. For cancellation / ยกเลิก lines use 'cancellation'; for return / คืนสินค้า lines use 'return'.

orders: one consistent COMPLETED-SALE INVOICE per row. invoice_id/customer_id/country strings; order_ts timestamp; order_amount decimal; total_units bigint; distinct_products bigint. Use for invoice counts, completed sales, AOV, purchasing customers, repeat rates. Anonymous customer_id NULL invoices are retained. Mixed customer/country invoices are excluded and counted in the build report. No transaction_type column exists in orders.

For sales, orders, AOV, purchasing/return/cancellation counts or repeat rates, require an explicit time period or an explicit request for the entire available dataset. If missing (เช่น ยอดขายรวมเท่าไร), ASK which period, never silently use all data.
